scope: Final RAG corpus: every seed scope page (State/Widgets/Forms/Rerun/Fragments docs and release notes) and every versioned API docstring record at the pinned docs commit. No Issue, comment, outcome, evaluation fixture or answer-linked document.
selection_policy: Select all records of sources/docs_scope_candidates.jsonl and sources/docstrings_scope_candidates.jsonl except denied_document_paths. Release notes keep source_type release_note with no inferred version; API records keep their exact docstring version; product docs are snapshot-dated with no version.
